parts.prompt: Read the passage, then answer questions 1 to 6. On March 4, 2025, the town council of Millbrook voted 5 to 2 to move the public library from its old building on Elm Street to the empty Hartwell factory beside the river. The Elm Street building is more than a hundred years old. Its roof leaks every spring, and it has no elevator, so readers who use wheelchairs cannot reach the upper floor. The factory has three times as much space and a large parking lot. Mayor Rosa Delgado said that the move would cost less than repairing the old roof. Councilor Tom Becker voted against the plan. He said that many children walk to the library after school, and the factory is two miles from the town center. The librarian, Ana Kim, asked the council to keep a small reading room open on Elm Street. The council agreed to discuss her request in June. The new library is planned to open in 2027. Where will the library move to? (A) a new building in the town center (B) the old Hartwell factory beside the river (C) the upper floor of the Elm Street building (D) the school on Elm Street
